title: THE LONG WAY BACK · 0 · The town
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop zero: Small Wood from the road out, the Datsun's hood, the dog. In the nightstand of the first motel, a card: a young man at a cliff's edge with a dog at his heel, drawn in the strip's own line. The traveler doesn't recognize himself. The reader does. Twenty-two stops; the book takes eight.
